verdicts.reason: The two candidates are essentially the same 300x250 layout. Each shrinks the logo symbols into a small top-left strip and splits the copy into two columns. The pink question is cramped into a narrow left column with awkward breaks ('YOU / CANNOT'). The 3-day-event body copy is tiny and hard to read, and the URL is pushed close to the bottom edge. B's body copy has slightly looser line spacing, but that is not enough to separate them.
